chunks: about a man departing in the first departure.

He said to him: "He may depart during the period between that and when the sun turns yellow. If he does not depart until it is near its setting, then he should not depart, and he should stay the night at Mina. Then when morning comes and the sun has risen, he may depart whenever he wishes."

key_terms.النَّفْرِ الْأَوَّلِ: the first permitted departure from Mina during hajj rites
key_terms.بِمِنًى: at Mina, the hajj campsite where pilgrims stay during the rites
key_terms.تَصْفَرَّ الشَّمْسُ: the sun turning yellow, indicating the late part of the day

ai.seo_question: Until what time may a pilgrim leave Mina during the first departure, and what if he delays until sunset?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about the timing of departure from Mina in the first departure during hajj. It states that departure is allowed before the sun yellows, but if one remains until near sunset, he must stay overnight in Mina and depart the next morning after sunrise.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3022 - Abu Basir asked Imam Abu Abdullah (as)
about a person leaving during the first departure (nafr al-awwal).

Imam (as) replied: "He may leave anytime between now and when the sun begins to turn yellow. However, if he does not depart until the time of sunset approaches, then he should not leave. Instead, he should stay the night in Mina, and when morning comes and the sun has risen, he may then depart whenever he wishes."
